title: Construct Quad Tree
goal: Represent a binary square grid as a quad tree that compresses uniform regions.
strategy: A prefix sum detects whether a region is all zero or all one. Uniform regions become leaves; mixed regions split into top-left top-right bottom-left and bottom-right quadrants.
